title: Evaluation of arterial stiffness and cardiac function in patients with vascular erectile dysfunction: acute effects of phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitor tadalafil - PubMed
abstract:
This study aimed to detect endothelial dysfunction in erectile dysfunction (ED) patients free from cardiovascular diseases or atherosclerotic risk factors and to evaluate acute effects of phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitor tadalafil on endothelial dysfunction and cardiac function. Thirty ED patients and 20 healthy male subjects (mean ages: 48.7±11.7 and 48.3±8.7 years, respectively) were enrolled.
